label: pitch above 90 with 3D terrain
reason: At pitch 95 with the center 1500 m high, the camera is below the plane of the center, and the level of detail of the tiles (the camZ term of coveringTiles in src/geo.ts) picks z14 to z16 tiles on the near face of the mountain, where MapLibre GL JS draws z12 and z13. The shape of the mountain and the skyline match.
